visualCharacteristics.summary: Small 90px 'Aa' squares in a wrapping grid with Background/Text captions
visualCharacteristics.purpose: accessible background/text colour pairings painted from named colours

contentPattern.summary: 13 contrast-pair tiles ('Aa' + Background/Text caption) | sub-brand-guide: 2 contrast tiles labelled Navy Blue/Process Blue and Navy Blue/Bright Blue (the rendered squares actually show Process Blue bg + Lime text and Lime bg + Process Blue text)
contentPattern.structure: one row per colour pairing; one cell: "Aa" paragraph, "Background: **Navy Blue**", "Text: **Process Blue**"

usage: One row per colour pairing: "Aa" sample paragraph, then "Background: **Colour**" and "Text: **Colour**" paragraphs using brand colour names (or CSS colours). The sample square is painted from those colours with captions below.

rows.row: each subsequent row = one contrast pair
cells: Cell 1 (text): 'Aa' sample paragraph, then 'Background: Navy Blue' and 'Text: Process Blue'

blockContent.behaviour: Block code maps the background and text colour names to brand colours and paints the 'Aa' square; captions sit below.
